entry_points.text: Bring-up adds disks and registers majors; holder link and unlink report success.
Sync, flush and discard delegate with sector conversion; splitting forwards by limits.
Bootconfig search delegates from null root; group locks init per element; cgroup attach is inert.
Field queries map kinds to sizes with warnings; object init and copy preserve specials.
Trampoline jump needs orig call without frame skip; array walks AND results until null.
Verifier keys pack object and type ids; spills check window; CFI and clocks expose control.

exports.text: Queue state predicates report single flags; capability queries expose rotation, zoning, multiqueue and sizes.
Zoned helpers map sectors to zones and detect straddles; bio iteration supports traversal and DMA mapping.
Block drivers use an operations table and holder callbacks; IO batches group requests with poll context.
Cgroup BPF exposes ingress, egress and address hooks with locked and unlocked filtering forms.
Map, device-map and verifier operations centralize allocation, lookup, update and program validation.
Helper prototypes fix calling convention; dispatcher and trampoline hooks handle binding and observation.
Program lookup by fd or id and unified kernel/user pointers with constructors are provided.
BTF queries, page markers and fixed/gate/divider/mux clock registration are exposed.

hazards.text: Unfrozen queue changes race readers; skipped straddle checks misroute writes; tail capacity applies at end.
Egress revalidates full-socket identity; failed probe copies zero destination; bugs warn once.
Trampoline bits, dispatcher size, complexity limits and access masks are fixed ABI.
Verifier caps cover offsets and maps; kfunc bits mark lifecycle and RCU roles.
Direct vector access faults on highmem and oversize folios may truncate; group violations fail build.
Queue, trace and BPF helpers depend on external atomic, bit, mutex and related helpers.
Unknown BTF kinds warn once with neutral metadata; races stay confined; display needs callback.

invariants.text: Zoned queries have live and compiled-out forms; zone plugging covers writes and atomic writes need aligned minima.
Bootconfig key/value follows high bit with byte-sum checksum; cgroup attach maps unknown types to invalid.
Base types use low 8 bits with modifiers; helper arity is fixed and registers mark roles.
Copies preserve specials; map flags map to read/write caps and struct-ops registration wraps payload.
Verifier classifies pointers and nullability; poison and percpu kinds are exposed and tracing needs aligned reads.
Vectors init from page or folio with capping; ring occupancy uses masked counts with one reserved slot.
Build assertions trap misuse; BTF payload follows header and ID sets are searched.
Unprivileged enablement and current-context presence each have enabled and always-negative builds.

locks.text: Elevator mutex guards scheduler with freeze-before-take order; limits mutex uses start/cancel pairing.
Freeze mutex guards once-fields; dispatcher and struct-ops have mutexes and counters use atomics.
Address helpers hold the socket lock only around the filter call; trace paths hold read protection.
One-shot guards state with mutex after fast check; clocks share an optional spinlock.

state_machines.text: Queue moves registered to quiesced with dying marking teardown; quiesced suspends dispatch.
Enabled tracing forwards when a trace object exists; disabled builds turn control into errors.
Maps go init to active with optional freeze then deferred free; struct-ops moves to in-use.
Tramp images publish as current while old images linger; dispatch routes by slot or direct.
Sleepable runs skip empty slots and AND results; one-shots run once; clocks follow prepare-enable.

structs.text: Queue tail holds elevator, limits and freeze mutexes, tag set, debug entries and RCU head.
Trace descriptor holds channel, sequences and list; compat setup carries device, buffers and pid.
Compat partition arg carries op and pointer; group locking uses an array; integrity max is fixed.
Bootconfig nodes pack four indices; magic length and alignment are fixed.
Cgroup state holds per-type arrays and release work; storage groups refcounted buffers.
Maps hold identity, flags and freeze mutex; arrays add size and mask; dynptr packs address.
Trampolines use skips and current/history images; dispatchers hold fixed tables with prog aux.
Verifier context holds positions, work stack, maps and logs; per-insn and kfunc records track state.
BSG jobs link buffers with timeout; BTF records hold fields; vectors and clocks link storage.
Cache descriptors link topology and devices; BTF ID sets count entries.
